title: Redstone Pack_1.21.5+
description: This resource pack is an updated version of Vunyx's Redstone Pack. It changes almost everything related to redstone, including wool textures.
body:
# Vunyx's Redstone Pack_1.21.5+

This resource pack is an updated version of Vunyx's Redstone Pack for Minecraft 1.21.5+.

Features:

- Updated redstone textures
- Connected wool textures
- Improved visibility for redstone components
- Better piston and observer indicators
- Support for Minecraft 1.21.5 to 26.1.2

Credits:
Original pack by Vunyx.
Updated for newer Minecraft versions by MAYAS.
